info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary: listShares returns the caller org's active shares.
get.description:
listShares returns the caller org's active shares.

A READ degrades to an honest-empty list when the org has no share account yet
or the controller is unreachable, so the console never error-toasts on load.

post.summary: enable provisions the caller org's share account and returns its credential.
post.description:
enable provisions the caller org's share account and returns its credential.

Provisioning is idempotent and the account is keyed deterministically off the
org, so this is a pure function of the validated identity — a caller can only
ever provision their OWN org's account.

accountToken.description: AccountToken is the org's zrok account token the CLI enables with.

controller.description: Controller is the public zrok controller endpoint to enable against.

namespace.description: Namespace is the public frontend the share is published under.

urlTemplate.description: URLTemplate is the share URL shape, with the token placeholder left in.

backend.description: Backend is the local endpoint the share proxies to.

backendMode.description: BackendMode is how the share serves its backend, e.g. proxy or web.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the share's creation time, unix seconds.

token.description: Token is the share's zrok token, the key in its public URL.

url.description: URL is the share's public URL.

shares.description: Shares is one row per active share across the org's environments.
